title: UK Payment Practices 2017-2026
description:
Aggregated UK statutory payment practices reporting, 2017 to 2026. Built from the complete public record of reports filed under the Reporting on Payment Practices and Performance Regulations 2017.

Three aggregate CSVs: trend by year, distribution of payment performance, and promise versus practice (agreed terms against actual payment).

Published by Finance Clearly, a publication of Edwards Bros (Spaldwick) Ltd.
